privileged_info_for_vlm: PDB 2LYZ (Hen Egg-White Lysozyme) has 129 residues. Typical secondary structure for 2LYZ includes alpha helices at approximately residues 5-15, 25-35, 80-84, 89-101, and 109-115. Beta strands are typically found around residues 43-46 and 51-54. The agent must use the 'iterate' command or the 'get_fastastr' logic to programmatically determine these, as manual counting is error-prone.
